title: Localized shifted roof with a specified endpoint identification
statement: Let C,D be categories with integer shifts and Q:C\to D a functor equipped with its specified shift comparison. Let e:X\to Y be a morphism such that Q(e) is invertible, and let s:Z\simeq Q(Y). For an integer q and F:X\to X[q], define the localized shifted roof at Z as the actual composite, in diagrammatic order: s.hom, Q(e)^{-1}, Q(F;e[q]), the comparison Q(Y[q])\simeq Q(Y)[q], and s.inv[q]. This merely packages the canonical shifted localization construction of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; it chooses no new data. Its proved API identifies the empty roof with the zero-shift identity and preserves shifted composition.

lean.statement:
def localizedShiftedRoof
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [HasShift C ℤ] [HasShift D ℤ]
    (Q : C ⥤ D) [Q.CommShift ℤ] {X Y : C} {Z : D}
    (e : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso (Q.map e)] (s : Z ≅ Q.obj Y) (q : ℤ)
    (F : X ⟶ X⟦q⟧) : Z ⟶ Z⟦q⟧
lean.note: Includes the original orderedShiftedArrows definition, moved verbatim and publicly reexported by InternalBarCharacterRoofCup; all three roof API equations are proved. Only the new localizedShiftedRoof wrapper is irreducible.
